name: Blood Moon — Changeling made a Forest land is a nonbasic land
notes: Memory: project_nonbasic_land_changeling_fix_2026-04-08. The 'nonbasic lands' filter wrongly excluded Changelings (isAllCreatureTypes guard applied to the Basic supertype). Life and Limb makes the Changeling (a Saproling) a nonbasic Forest land; Blood Moon must then make it a Mountain, not leave it a Forest.
